_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. Approach A (composer) compiles all three assets. The template names the user's own handler and content finder <Feature>PublishedHandler / <Feature>ContentFinder; ExampleTypes.cs supplies those two types for <Feature> = ComposingExample. Approach B reuses these same assets plus one Program.cs line, which the shared host cannot carry, so it has no example of its own.
